threads.name: Creation → New Creation
threads.description: From cosmos born to cosmos redeemed. The arc of creation's meaning unfolds from Genesis to Revelation.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. He saw that it was good.
threads.newTestamentExpression: Behold, I make all things new.

stages.title: Creation Established
stages.description: God speaks creation into being. Order emerges from void. Matter and spirit dance in harmony.

stages.title: Creation Marred
stages.description: Sin enters. Harmony fractures. Creation groans under the weight of separation from God.

stages.title: Creation Restored in Christ
stages.description: Through Christ, all things are reconciled. The new creation begins now and reaches fulfillment.

threads.fulfillment: Christ as the image of the invisible God; in Him all things hold together. The cosmos finds its meaning in His redemption.

threads.name: Covenant → New Covenant
threads.description: From promise to fulfillment. God's steadfast commitment deepens through history and reaches its apex in Christ.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: I will be your God, and you will be my people.
threads.newTestamentExpression: This is my blood of the covenant, poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

stages.title: Covenant Promised
stages.description: God makes one-sided promises: to Abraham, Moses, David. Grace precedes response.

stages.title: Covenant Inscribed in Law
stages.description: The covenant takes form in commandments. Law reveals both God's will and human inability.

stages.title: Covenant Fulfilled in Christ
stages.description: Christ is the yes to all God's promises. His blood seals a new and eternal covenant.

threads.fulfillment: Christ fulfills all covenants. In Him, God's promises are secured and transformed into grace alone.

threads.name: Sacrifice → Redemption
threads.description: From offering to liberation. Sacrifice moves from appeasement to the redemptive act that frees all creation.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: The lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world.
threads.newTestamentExpression: Christ our Passover has been sacrificed for us.

stages.title: Sacrifice as Type
stages.description: Animals offered for sin, for peace, for thanksgiving. Each gesture points toward something fuller.

stages.title: Sacrifice as Substitution
stages.description: The Passover lamb dies so that Israel lives. One dies for the many.

stages.title: Sacrifice Fulfilled and Ended
stages.description: Christ's sacrifice is once for all. No more offerings needed. All debts are paid.

threads.fulfillment: Christ is the Lamb of God whose blood redeems not just individuals but all of creation.

threads.name: Kingship → Christ the King
threads.description: From earthly rule to cosmic sovereignty. Authority moves from temporal thrones to the eternal reign of Christ.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: The Lord is King forever and ever.
threads.newTestamentExpression: Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

stages.title: Kingship Earthly and Limited
stages.description: Saul, David, Solomon rule. They are anointed representatives of God's kingdom, yet fallible.

stages.title: Kingship Hoped For
stages.description: After exile, the people long for a messiah-king who will reign forever and establish true justice.

stages.title: Kingship Revealed in Christ
stages.description: Jesus is the King—not through earthly power but through love, sacrifice, and resurrection. His kingdom is not of this world.

threads.fulfillment: Christ reigns eternally. All authority in heaven and earth is His. The kingdom of God is now and not yet.

threads.name: Logos → Word Made Flesh
threads.description: From divine speech to incarnation. God's self-expression moves from word to flesh, from revelation to presence.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
threads.newTestamentExpression: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us.

stages.title: Logos as Divine Speech
stages.description: God speaks creation into being. His word is power, truth, and covenant. Wisdom speaks in Proverbs.

stages.title: Logos as Revelation
stages.description: God's word comes to the prophets. It is living and active. It judges and heals.

stages.title: Logos Incarnate
stages.description: The eternal Word becomes human flesh. God is not merely heard; God is seen, touched, and known in Jesus.

threads.fulfillment: Jesus Christ is the full revelation of God. In Him, the invisible God becomes visible. The Word takes flesh to dwell with us.

threads.name: Presence → God With Us
threads.description: From distant holiness to indwelling communion. The presence of God moves from temple to people to the hearts of believers.
threads.oldTestamentExpression: They heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day.
threads.newTestamentExpression: God with us, Emmanuel. I am with you always, to the end of the age.

stages.title: Presence: Distant and Holy
stages.description: God dwells in unapproachable light. Moses cannot see His face. The temple separates holy from profane.

stages.title: Presence Promised in Flesh
stages.description: The prophets speak of God's intention to dwell with His people. Emmanuel. God pitches a tent among us.

stages.title: Presence: Intimate and Indwelling
stages.description: Christ is Emmanuel—God with us. Through the Spirit, God indwells believers. The body of Christ becomes God's temple.

threads.fulfillment: God no longer dwells at a distance. In Christ, the infinite becomes intimate. The Holy Spirit makes God's presence personal and immediate.
